What you agree to, and what we keep
Boondh connects you with local shops
The shops on Boondh are independent businesses. They fill, seal and deliver the water. We check their licences and visit their shops, and we step in when something goes wrong.
Your delivery code is your receipt
Every order has a 6-digit code. Tell it to the driver only when the water is at your door. Once the driver enters it, the order counts as delivered.
If you don\'t swap an empty jar, you pay a refundable deposit, shown before you pay. Return the jar within %1$d days and the deposit comes back the way you chose for refunds.
Free until the driver leaves the shop. After that, a prepaid order keeps %1$s for the driver\'s trip and the rest comes back. Cash orders are never charged for cancelling.
Each delivery is paid when it arrives, the way you chose. Skip, pause or change it before %1$s the night before.
Money you add or get back can be sent to your bank. Referral credit can only be spent on orders.
One account per phone number. Don\'t let anyone else use yours to order or deliver. We may pause an account that is used to fake orders or deliveries.
Tell us from the order screen. We look at the door photo, the shop\'s records and the driver\'s trip before we decide, and refunds go back the way you chose.
We tell you in the app before a change applies. Using Boondh after that means you accept it.
These terms follow the laws of India. Courts in Hyderabad, Telangana handle any dispute.
Shared with the shop and the driver only while they deliver to you. Drivers see your first name, not your full name.
Used to find shops that deliver to your door, and to show you where your driver is while the water is on its way. Only while the app is in use. Never sold or shared.
Handled by Razorpay. Boondh never sees your UPI PIN or full card number.
Drivers photograph the jars at your door so any dispute is settled fairly. Only you, the shop and the driver on that order can open the photo.
The Call button opens your phone\'s dialer. Numbers are shared only during an active order and hidden again once it ends.
We note which phone you sign in from, to keep your account safe and to stop fake orders.
Order updates always come through. Offers only if you turn them on.
Takes 30 days, in case you change your mind. Invoices stay 8 years because tax law says so.
We can\'t see where you are
Location is off for Boondh, so we can\'t find suppliers near you. We only use it to show who delivers to your door — never shared with anyone.
